principle: Semantic/domain identity is stable across rebuilds; packed carrier identity is an exact build artifact receipt and may change between rebuilds.
identity_rules: semantic_object_id is the stable machine-readable identity for the domain/filespace meaning
carrier_instance_object_id is the CGX kernel instance identity for one concrete rebuilt carrier
carrier_sha256 identifies exact persisted bytes and never substitutes for semantic identity
content_root/dbr_root/topology identify verified semantic/build state within a carrier
a rebuild may preserve semantic_object_id while changing carrier_instance_object_id and carrier_sha256
promotion/readback must name both the stable semantic identity and the exact carrier byte receipt
